resources.string: Applies your chosen grayscale setting when an app comes to the foreground, then restores your display settings when you leave it. Detects app window changes only. Does not read screen text or send activity data anywhere.

Shows your optional Launcher status strip and quick panel across apps. Detects foreground window changes to hide on the lock screen and system permission screens. Does not read screen text, record gestures outside its handle or send activity data anywhere. Disable System panel in Launcher Settings to remove the overlay.
